prompt: In step 1 you rebuilt the first frame of an animated GIF as inline SVG. Your step 1 page is below. The attached images are eight keyframes of the same GIF, in order, at these times from the loop start: image 1 at 0 ms, image 2 at 800 ms, image 3 at 1530 ms, image 4 at 2330 ms, image 5 at 3130 ms, image 6 at 3930 ms, image 7 at 4670 ms, image 8 at 5470 ms. The GIF loops every 5540 ms. Task (2D, animation): animate your step 1 page so that it matches the GIF's motion at those times. Start from your step 1 SVG; you may fix or improve it. The animation loops with a period of exactly 5540 ms, and t = 0 must match the first keyframe. Use exactly one of these timing methods, never both: A. Declarative: CSS @keyframes, SMIL, or the Web Animations API (element.animate). Every animation starts at page load and repeats forever. The harness pauses all animations with document.getAnimations() and SVGSVGElement.setCurrentTime() and seeks them to each time. B. Scripted: define window.nwb = { render(t) }, where render(t) updates the SVG synchronously to the frame at time t in milliseconds. The same t must always produce the same image, whatever was rendered before. 2D contract: - The page body contains a single inline
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

</head>
<body>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="240" height="294" viewBox="0 0 240 294" role="img" aria-label="A round golden figure gesturing and turning sideways">
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="backdrop" x2=".04" y2="1">
    <stop stop-color="#e6e4dc"/><stop offset=".08" stop-color="#e7e8f5"/>
    <stop offset=".17" stop-color="#e7edff"/><stop offset=".25" stop-color="#fff9ef"/>

    <stop offset=".89" stop-color="#eae2ce"/><stop offset=".94" stop-color="#c7c4ba"/>

  </linearGradient>
  <radialGradient id="ground"><stop stop-color="#9c9995" stop-opacity=".6"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#aaa6a0" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
  <linearGradient id="leg" x2="1" y2=".15">
    <stop stop-color="#9c5e13"/><stop offset=".26" stop-color="#c37d18"/><stop offset=".58" stop-color="#d68b23"/><stop offset=".85" stop-color="#d48d2c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ac691c"/>
  </linearGradient>

  <radialGradient id="headGold" cx=".47" cy=".21" r=".8"><stop stop-color="#f6cf40"/><stop offset=".34" stop-color="#ebbc2e"/><stop offset=".62" stop-color="#d7a323"/><stop offset=".81" stop-color="#dfa224"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#efb131" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
  <radialGradient id="chin"><stop stop-color="#b7790d" stop-opacity=".82"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#c38b11" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
  <linearGradient id="armGold" x1=".18" y1="0" x2=".78" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#efb823"/><stop offset=".32" stop-color="#ffd044"/><stop offset=".58" stop-color="#f5b732"/><stop offset=".84" stop-color="#dda026"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#bc872b"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="hand" x2=".8" y2=".8"><stop stop-color="#9b7b37"/><stop offset=".4" stop-color="#635036"/><stop offset=".83" stop-color="#41382b"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#574932"/></linearGradient>
  <radialGradient id="iris"><stop stop-color="#020c06"/><stop offset=".57" stop-color="#041106"/><stop offset=".83" stop-color="#184721"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#64894a"/></radialGradient>
  <filter id="soft" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="130%" height="130%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation=".78"/></filter>
  <filter id="blend"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3"/></filter>
  <path id="bodyShape"/>
  <clipPath id="bodyClip"><use href="#bodyShape"/></clipPath>
  <path id="palm" d="M-4.9 -4 Q0 -6 4.9 -3 Q8 1 8.4 6 L12 12 Q12.8 15 11 15 Q9.6 15 6 10 L7.8 19 Q8 22 6 21 Q4 20 2 12 L2.7 23 Q2.4 25 1 24 Q-.7 23 -2 13 L-3 22 Q-4.4 24 -5.3 21 L-5 12 Q-7 18 -8.6 17 Q-10 16 -8 10 Q-7.6 5 -6 1Z"/>
  <pattern id="screen" width="6" height="6" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
    <path fill="#5478ca" opacity=".36" d="M0 0h1v1H0z M3 3h1v1H3z"/>
    <path fill="#ffbc32" opacity=".46" d="M2 1h1v1H2z M5 4h1v1H5z"/>
    <path fill="#fffbde" opacity=".48" d="M4 0h1v1H4z M1 3h1v1H1z"/>
    <path fill="#9e91ae" opacity=".25" d="M0 2h1v1H0z M3 5h1v1H3z"/>
    <path fill="#fff" opacity=".5" d="M2 4h1v1H2z M5 1h1v1H5z"/>
  </pattern>
</defs>
<g id="background"><rect width="240" height="294" fill="url(#backdrop)"/><ellipse cx="107" cy="289" rx="114" ry="11" fill="url(#ground)"/></g>
<g id="golden-character" filter="url(#soft)">
  <g id="legs">
    <g id="leg-viewer-right"><path id="rightLeg" fill="url(#leg)"/></g>
    <g id="leg-viewer-left"><path id="leftLeg" fill="url(#legLight)"/></g>
  </g>
  <g id="back-arms"></g>
  <g id="torso">
    <use href="#bodyShape" fill="url(#skin)"/>
    <g clip-path="url(#bodyClip)">
      <ellipse id="chestLight" fill="url(#chest)"/>
      <ellipse id="bellyShadow" fill="url(#bellyShade)"/>
      <use href="#bodyShape" fill="url(#edge)"/>
      <ellipse id="neckShadow" fill="url(#chin)"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g id="head">
    <path fill="url(#headGold)" d="M77 43 C79 34 81 26 89 21 C95 16 103 17 111 20 Q120 22 122 33 Q124 40 122 48 C121 57 116 67 107 72 Q94 76 82 66 Q73 58 77 43Z"/>
    <g id="eyes" fill="url(#iris)">
      <ellipse id="leftEye"/><ellipse id="rightEye"/>
    </g>
    <g id="muzzle"><g id="mouth"><path id="smile" fill="none" stroke="#88621e" stroke-width="1.65" stroke-linecap="round"/></g></g>
  </g>
  <g id="front-arms">
    <g id="arm-viewer-right"><path id="rightSleeve" fill="url(#armGold)"/><g id="right-hand"><use href="#palm" fill="url(#hand)"/></g></g>
    <g id="arm-viewer-left"><path id="leftSleeve" fill="url(#armGold)"/><g id="left-hand"><use href="#palm" fill="url(#hand)"/></g></g>
  </g>
</g>
<rect width="240" height="294" fill="url(#screen)" opacity=".83" pointer-events="none"/>
<script>
(() => {
  const get=id=>document.getElementById(id);
  const times=[0,800,1530,2330,3130,3930,4670,5470,5540];
  // Head center/top, head scale, shoulders, belly bounds, hip center/base, profile.
  const shape=[
    [100,18,1,1,64,129,65,38,157,162,97,239,0],
    [76,43,1.04,.97,40,102,88,9,127,182,67,242,0],
    [90,31,1,1,53,124,77,34,150,175,94,232,0],
    [113,-25,1.39,1.43,51,170,62,24,194,202,110,285,0],
    [89,12,1.08,1.02,49,134,64,31,166,176,99,245,0],
    [105,21,1.05,1,78,151,75,55,176,165,114,230,1],
    [108,22,1.04,1,85,163,77,68,197,174,140,238,1],
    [99,19,.99,1,83,158,76,67,197,163,141,228,1]
  ];
  // Shoulder, elbow, wrist, finger direction, palm width and length.
  const left=[
    [67,71,48,126,35,185,18,.84,1.25],
    [49,91,57,132,83,86,-143,1,.78],
    [56,84,55,151,54,121,172,1.12,1.26],
    [59,72,42,156,20,196,66,1.16,1.44],
    [54,72,55,145,69,113,167,1.42,1.02],
    [103,79,54,108,43,56,207,.88,.82],
    [112,83,58,117,42,77,157,.72,.7],
    [99,87,125,157,152,220,-40,.96,1.04]
  ];
  const right=[
    [126,72,144,128,158,192,-14,.86,1.18],
    [98,93,109,117,104,86,165,.96,.82],
    [122,88,155,136,170,127,-68,.81,.94],
    [165,73,174,152,188,220,-4,.65,.46],
    [130,71,149,146,161,207,-17,.81,1.1],
    [99,81,56,110,28,90,116,.65,1.28],
    [107,84,62,119,28,99,116,.62,1.32],
    [125,86,153,149,157,211,-14,.75,.83]
  ];
  // Upper and lower edges of each leg.
  const legs=[
    [53,102,73,95,95,143,101,125],
    [20,68,34,56,61,115,72,97],
    [46,101,75,101,88,143,108,136],
    [43,111,52,104,100,177,111,166],
    [47,103,72,98,95,152,108,133],
    [81,124,97,127,87,150,97,122],
    [96,148,127,163,91,141,97,124],
    [111,159,116,138,99,148,101,124]
  ];
  // Local eye positions, openness and smile curvature.
  const face=[
    [86,114,38,.14,1,102,48,2],
    [91,118,37,1,.76,110,49,3],
    [85,115,41,1,1,101,54,4],
    [84,113,42,1,1,100,55,-3],
    [84,116,42,1,1,100,56,4],
    [80,82,35,.79,.04,80,50,1],
    [80,82,36,.85,.04,81,50,1],
    [79,81,38,.82,.04,81,53,1]
  ];
  function ellipse(id,x,y,rx,ry){
    const el=get(id);
    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries({cx:x,cy:y,rx,ry}))el.setAttribute(k,v);
  }
  function limb(side,data){
    const [sx,sy,ex,ey,wx,wy,angle,width,length]=data;
    const a=[],b=[];
    // Round the elbow by joining two quadratic segments at its center.
    const mx=(sx+ex)/2,my=(sy+ey)/2,nx=(ex+wx)/2,ny=(ey+wy)/2;
    for(let j=0;j<=32;j++){
      const u=j/32;
      let x,y,dx,dy;
      if(u<.25){
        const v=u*4;
        x=sx+(mx-sx)*v;y=sy+(my-sy)*v;dx=mx-sx;dy=my-sy;
      }else if(u>.75){
        const v=(u-.75)*4;
        x=nx+(wx-nx)*v;y=ny+(wy-ny)*v;dx=wx-nx;dy=wy-ny;
      }else{
        const v=(u-.25)*2,h=1-v;
        x=h*h*mx+2*h*v*ex+v*v*nx;y=h*h*my+2*h*v*ey+v*v*ny;
        dx=h*(ex-mx)+v*(nx-ex);dy=h*(ey-my)+v*(ny-ey);
      }
      const radius=11.7*(1-u)+4.4*u+2.2*Math.sin(Math.PI*u);
      const k=radius/(Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1);
      a.push([x-dy*k,y+dx*k]);b.push([x+dy*k,y-dx*k]);
    }
    get(side+'Sleeve').setAttribute('d','M'+a.join(' L')+' L'+b.reverse().join(' L')+'Z');
    get(side+'-hand').setAttribute('transform',`translate(${wx} ${wy}) rotate(${angle}) scale(${width} ${length})`);
  }
  function render(t){
    const clock=((t%5540)+5540)%5540;
    let i=0;while(clock>=times[i+1])i++;
    let u=(clock-times[i])/(times[i+1]-times[i]);u=u*u*(3-2*u);
    function pose(table){
      return table[i].map((v,k)=>v+(table[(i+1)%8][k]-v)*u);
    }
    const [hx,top,hs,vs,sl,sr,sh,l,r,y,c,base,profile]=pose(shape);
    const w=r-l;
    const lt=hx-20*hs,rt=hx+20*hs,h=top+21*vs;
    get('bodyShape').setAttribute('d',`M${lt} ${h}
      C${lt-3} ${h+12} ${sl+4} ${sh-9} ${sl} ${sh}
      C${sl-8} ${sh+15} ${l} ${y-24} ${l} ${y}
      C${l} ${y+29} ${c-w*.39} ${base-14} ${c-w*.27} ${base-5}
      C${c-w*.14} ${base+2} ${c+w*.13} ${base+3} ${c+w*.27} ${base-5}
      C${r-9} ${base-17} ${r+1} ${y+24} ${r} ${y}
      C${r} ${y-21} ${sr+9} ${sh+20} ${sr} ${sh}
      C${sr-5} ${sh-12} ${rt+3} ${h+10} ${rt} ${h}
      Q${hx} ${top-3} ${lt} ${h}Z`);
    ellipse('chestLight',c+w*(.025-.34*profile),sh+(y-sh)*.63,w*.56,(y-sh)*.47);
    ellipse('bellyShadow',c+w*(.07-.28*profile),y-7,w*.5,30);
    get('bellyShadow').setAttribute('opacity',1-.62*profile);
    ellipse('neckShadow',hx,top+45*vs,31*hs,31*vs);
    get('head').setAttribute('transform',`translate(${hx} ${top}) scale(${hs} ${vs}) translate(-100 -18)`);
    const [xl,xr,ey,open,far,mx,my,curve]=pose(face);
    ellipse('leftEye',xl,ey,4.5-profile*2,5.1*open);
    ellipse('rightEye',xr,ey-.3,4.35*far,5.15*open*far);
    get('eyes').setAttribute('opacity',Math.min(1,.29+open*.85));
    const mw=9.6*(1-profile*.73);
    get('smile').setAttribute('d',`M${mx-mw} ${my} Q${mx} ${my+curve} ${mx+mw} ${my-.4}`);
    const lg=pose(legs);
    for(let j=0;j<2;j++){
      const [a,b,d,e]=lg.slice(j*4,j*4+4),hip=base-35;
      get(j?'rightLeg':'leftLeg').setAttribute('d',`M${a} ${hip} Q${(a+d)/2-2} ${hip+38} ${d} 296 L${e} 296 Q${(b+e)/2} ${hip+39} ${b} ${hip}Z`);
    }
    limb('left',pose(left));limb('right',pose(right));
    const nearLeft=(clock>310&&clock<1970)||(clock>2690&&clock<5220)||profile>.9;
    const nearRight=(clock>340&&clock<1870);
    for(const [side,near] of [['right',nearRight],['left',nearLeft]]){
      const el=get('arm-viewer-'+side);
      get(near?'front-arms':'back-arms').appendChild(el);
    }
  }
  window.nwb={render};
  render(0);
})();
</script>
</svg>
</body>
</html>
